introHtml: Cotton-poly blends combine the softness of cotton with the durability and wrinkle resistance of polyester. For bulk buyers, this means uniforms and promo apparel that hold their shape wash after wash, while staying comfortable for all-day wear. Whether you need sweatpants for a casual company event or shorts for a safety team, cotton-poly fabric offers a reliable balance of breathability and longevity. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery for a polished look.
